issuer_source.note: BOB foundation token whitepaper and CMC listing identify the Build on Bitcoin L2 token.
Issuer identifies GUN as the native protocol token and the currency used by Off The Grid; CMC listing is GUNZ.

Issuer identifies MINT as the Mint Blockchain ecosystem token, with contract 0x8511138208529fe1b9a37b863c7EEE3Fe234b7Ab on Mint, OP Mainnet and Base. CMC has matching symbol and contract suffix; its page is a preview listing and does not prove live quote availability.

Select issuer-documented New QUICK: current utility belongs to New holders, and issuer Ethereum contract matches the provider explorer target. Old UCID 8206 is not selected. Record the 1:1000 migration for provenance only; no price/supply/snapshot multiplication or wallet transaction is performed.

Issuer mainnet registry names the CLEAR token and full contract, matching the provider explorer target. Do not merge the separate originally unmapped connext record by alias. Provider page is a preview; valid quote availability is pending.

Provider listing explicitly names SEED NFT Marketplace and links Seed.Photo plus this BNB contract; provider-linked explorer identifies Seed.Photo. Issuer website fetch timed out, so do not claim independent issuer-contract confirmation or completed sector taxonomy. Retain quarantine until live validation.

Provider identifies OpenEden TBILL Vault; issuer documentation names TBILL and its Ethereum contract with the same provider contract prefix/suffix. Preserve the TBILL product identity; do not substitute EDEN governance or USDO. Preview listing does not establish a market price, NAV or FDV.

Current issuer asset page identifies Invesco USTB and the Ethereum contract prefix/suffix matching the provider. Primary Invesco release states that the manager/name transition maintains the USTB ticker, contracts and token address. Do not substitute USCC or assume a $1 price. Preview listing requires live quote validation.

Manual identity review: issuer documents INST-to-FLUID 1:1 rebrand with the same token address/supply; current issuer branding and provider FLUID listing agree. Provider explorer target matches the issuer Ethereum address. Preserve catalog INST as provenance; no multiplication of stored values and no wallet operation.

Manual catalog correction: issuer names WalletConnect Token WCT, not WC. Issuer deployment repository and provider explorer target agree on this full Ethereum address. Preserve WC as the old catalog input; do not claim a real WC-to-WCT token migration.

Manual catalog correction: issuer names NEURON and its purchase link identifies this Ethereum token. The provider explorer target has the identical full address. Preserve NEURO as the old catalog input; do not invent a historical NEURO token or rebrand.

Issuer documentation identifies the Revenant Finance/Fantom lending protocol and CREDIT rewards, matching provider Creditum/CREDIT metadata. This is not a similarly named consumer-credit business. Provider preview listing and archived protocol documentation do not establish current quote availability or lifecycle.

Issuer identifies PollenCoin PCN and provider explicitly associates it with Pollen Mobile, not Pollen/PLN. Issuer internal-network $0.10 denomination has no cash value and is not a stablecoin peg; it must not become a spot quote, market cap or FDV. Keep quarantine until both a valid external quote and its market applicability are established; strict numeric PASS alone is insufficient for this special case.

Issuer terms explicitly define GAFI as the GameFi.org token; the current homepage/staking page use GAFI and identify BSC participation. Provider UCID 11783 is GameFi.org/GAFI, slug gamefi, linked to the same issuer domain. Correct the catalog input GFI and unrelated SOLI mapping; do not invent a historical GameFi GFI token or migration. No independent full issuer contract match was obtained.

Search-retrieved text from the issuer-hosted whitepaper explicitly uses SPON for compute-network payments/staking/rewards. Provider UCID 37537 is Spheron Network/SPON, slug spheron-network, with the matching issuer domain and Base explorer reference. The direct PDF fetch failed, and current commercial homepage does not mention SPON; current lifecycle/quote availability are not established. Correct the catalog input SPHN without inventing an enacted SPHN-to-SPON token migration. No independent full issuer contract match was obtained; the provider page is a preview.

Issuer homepage links the reviewed GitBook, whose tokenomics explicitly specify NB and BEP-20 for the physical/environmental data network. Provider UCID 38816 is Nubila Network/NB with the same issuer/docs links, slug nubila-network. Correct the catalog input NUB and unrelated GPT-1 ID; do not claim that NUB was an actual former Nubila token. Legacy presale NUBI language is not migration/contract proof. No independent full issuer contract match was obtained.

Issuer explicitly names PORTX as ChainPort utility token and publishes the full Ethereum address. Provider UCID 17480 is ChainPort/PORTX, slug chainport, with matching issuer links and contract prefix/suffix; full provider explorer fetching failed, so no independently fetched full-contract match is claimed. Correct the catalog PORT input and unrelated C4E ID without claiming a token migration. Provider preview renders an unexplained total-supply string 679814605.44E PORTX. Do not interpret or scale that UI text into financial values; review fresh raw supply/units and associated MC/FDV validity before release even if the unchanged strict quote audit passes.

Issuer holder documentation identifies SYRUP as the current Maple utility/governance token and states the final MPL conversion extension closed on 2025-05-21. The historic holder conversion was 1 MPL to 100 SYRUP; it is not an open entitlement or a multiplier for any stored price/supply/snapshot. Issuer FAQ publishes this full SYRUP address, agreeing with the provider abbreviation at UCID 33824. Retain project canonical maple and archive MPL; current SYRUP quotes must never be described as legacy MPL quotes. Old UCID 9417/MPL is not selected; the existing 13632 was an unrelated GENE mapping. This is current-project asset selection after an enacted migration, not wallet/balance conversion.

Issuer migration update and completion announcement identify CXT as the replacement network token and CQT as deprecated. The snapshot-based 1:1 distribution was historical; post-snapshot CQT purchases do not imply a present CXT entitlement, and no swap portal/action is performed here. Issuer-hosted search text publishes the full CXT address, matching the abbreviation at provider UCID 32526. UCID 7411 remains the archived legacy CQT identity, not an arbitrary wrong-project ID. Keep canonical covalent while explicitly selecting current CXT; never relabel a CXT quote as CQT.

Issuer .xyz docs explicitly describe Dopex becoming Stryke and introducing SYK. Its official SYK-is-here article, linked by the provider migration notice and republished by the issuer, announces enacted DPX/rDPX-to-SYK migration and publishes this full address, agreeing with the abbreviation at UCID 32215. Select current SYK for the permanent project ID dopex; retain DPX and the unrelated HERA mapping as provenance. Legacy DPX UCID 11188 is not selected. No xSYK/rDPX substitution, conversion-ratio scaling, wallet transaction or assertion of an open migration window is introduced. Unverified similarly named domains are not issuer evidence.

Issuer announcement dated 2026-06-25 explicitly changes Story to The DATA Foundation, IP to DATA and Story Network to DATA Network. Provider story-protocol URL now redirects to data-network, UCID 35626/DATA, and links the same issuer/docs. The old 29147 mapping returned unrelated MEMEMUSK. Current issuer docs say DATA remains the protocol token during a planned Sui upgrade, while the independent chain continues until completion; do not claim the upgrade is complete. Select current DATA for permanent project ID story-protocol and archive IP. Current DATA quotes must not be labelled as IP. Provider contract abbreviation is recorded only; no independently fetched full issuer/provider contract match or chain execution is claimed. Separate canonical streamr/DATA 2143 remains unchanged; never merge by ticker.

Issuer Moonchain mainnet configuration identifies MXC as native symbol on chain 18686. Its old-to-new bridge documentation publishes the new Arbitrum MXC address, agreeing with the displayed provider prefix/suffix at UCID 3628/MXC/mxc. The provider links mxc.com/doc.mxc.com and records L1-to-L3 migration; the old 5733 mapping returned unrelated IOOX. Retain symbol MXC and permanent project ID. Provider is a preview listing, current quote availability is not established, and the old ERC20 bridge is marked discontinued; no bridge action, current conversion window, ratio or financial scaling is inferred. No independent full provider-explorer retrieval is claimed.

Current Matrixdock homepage/product and issuer token-features documentation explicitly identify STBT as its rebasing short-term US Treasury/repo token, distinct from wSTBT and gold/silver products. Provider UCID 28055 is STBT/short-term-t-bill-token and links stbt.matrixdock.com. Its displayed contract 0x5308...45b44a agrees with the provider-linked Ethereum explorer target 0x530824da86689c9c17cdc2871ff29b058345b44a. Explorer retrieval returned 403 and a full issuer contract was not retrieved; do not claim independent full-address matching. Archive the unrelated DOGE mapping. Issuer describes whitelisting/accredited-investor restrictions and rebasing; no fixed $1 spot quote, NAV substitution, redemption eligibility or unrestricted tradability is inferred. Strict quotes remain pending.

Issuer USDM contract and provider abbreviation agree; UCID 29569 links the same issuer and its wind-down notice. Old 27788 returned TEST. Phase-3 terms effective 2025-08-22 supersede legacy mint/redeem and yield descriptions: issuer platform is decommissioned and no price, liquidity or peg is guaranteed. Correct identity but retain quarantine, with a lifecycle gate beyond numeric PASS. Do not substitute USDC, wUSDM, a redemption value or a fixed $1 spot price. No current full provider explorer-address retrieval is claimed.
